artifact: epic #307 evidence: step timings, window flags, reader A/B, epic comparison

host.note: the load at the run's start and end; the reader A/B records a load per sample

method_note: A step's wall_seconds is its record's elapsed_seconds and its phases need not sum to it. A phase's span comes from its two log lines; the log's own `done in` value is minute-rounded, so it is recorded beside the span, not instead of it. Windows are half-open intervals on the log lines' clock (host local time). A phase's clean rate is pooled over the progress intervals that fall entirely outside every window; the pace on the last line before a window is recorded beside it.

daily.basis: assumed to repeat nightly from the 22 Oct observation (about 01:06 to about 16:10 BST, judging by when Pass 2 slowed and when the z band-write recovered), applied back to --daily-from because OGS-00016's October build slows from its first night in the same hours; September's records are not covered, the epic having read them as clean. The backup stopped covering /data/opengwasdb on 2 Nov 2026, which is why --until is exclusive there

stores_note: These are timing baselines: each Store's steps, phases and clean rates, re-derived from its own records. The store bytes are not measured, and a Store re-encoded after its build still has the build's records.

comparison.rule: a point value reproduces when it is within 5% of the epic's (or one second, for a value measured in seconds); a lower bound reproduces when the measurement meets it; a range reproduces when the measurement falls inside it. A sum with any component excluded is a lower bound and is not called yes or no.
